name: dmr
label: DMR (native decoder + voice)
description: DMR Tier II / repeater: call metadata (talkgroup, radio ID, colour code, talker alias) and AMBE+2 voice, decoded entirely by Ferrite — runs node-side or in the browser.
ai_notes: DMR (Tier II conventional / repeater) decoded end to end by Ferrite's DmrDecode: call records (`call` with slot, TG, source ID, CC, ENC — voice LC header or embedded LC late entry — `end` with duration, `alias`, `sync`) in `ui:dsd`, and AMBE+2 speech via the vendored mbelib vocoder on the audio chain (`listen`: both slots mixed, or 1 / 2; `slot1`/`slot2` ports carry each slot). Encrypted calls: events, no audio. Runs node-side or browser-side (the browser fetches the 54 KB vocoder module lazily). For P25 / NXDN / D-STAR / YSF use the `dsd-fme` preset. Verified 2026-10-13 from bigear on Antenna B, gain 40: 441.850 MHz DMR repeater (colour code 1; slot 2 TG 31068, slot 1 TG 93; talker aliases), also TG 31068 traffic on 440.125 and 440.5875 MHz. Tune on-centre of the 12.5 kHz channel. Output: `tail decoder --category dsd`; `await dsd`.
